title: Geotab - Top EV range factors to extend fleet efficiency (temperature range curve)
notes: Published 2025-10-30. 5.2 million trips by 4,200 EVs (102 make/model/year): range peaks at 115 % of rated at 21.5 °C, is at or above rated from 10 to 31 °C, and falls to 54 % of rated at -15 °C. B116 anchors at -15 °C and 10-15 °C.
